verdict.rationale: Ghostty's features docs state that it supports the Kitty graphics protocol, a documented terminal graphics protocol that lets terminal applications render images directly in the terminal. Its docs also point developers to a reference on supported control sequences. The evidence is a short first-party claim with no further depth. Missing for 10: details on how much of the Kitty protocol is implemented (animation, placements, rich graphics), any mention of other protocols such as Sixel or iTerm2 inline images, and independent or hands-on corroboration that image rendering works.
